title: Battle Result
description: One completed battle outcome as the route layer returns it (POST /battle/simulate, /friendly, /ranked, /dungeon). winner/turns/events/hpLeft/faints come from services/battleEngine.ts; events follow battle-event.json. Faint lists feed faint persistence (daily reset / nutrition-task recovery).

events.description: The deterministic replay stream — identical on server and client for the same squads + seed.

hpLeftA.description: End-of-battle HP fractions for side A's squad, in order.

faintedA.description: Side-A units that ended at 0 HP — stay fainted post-battle.

faintedB.description: Side-B units that ended at 0 HP.
